info.name: nCino Mortgage Loan Officer Loan Doc Tasks API
🚧 Retrieve all loan doc tasks across a loan officer's loans (BETA)

params.name: closing_date_end
params.description: Only include tasks whose parent loan closes on or before this date.

params.name: closing_date_start
params.description: Only include tasks whose parent loan closes on or after this date.

params.name: doc_type
params.description: Doc type by which to filter loan doc tasks.

params.name: loan_borrower_id
params.description: Loan Borrower ID by which to filter loan doc tasks.

params.name: resolved
params.description: Filter by completion status. `true` returns completed tasks, `false` returns unresolved tasks.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records returned in each page.

params.name: created_after
params.description: The date which a resource must be created after to be returned.

params.name: created_before
params.description: The date which a resource must be created before to be returned.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: The date which a resource must be updated after to be returned.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: The date which a resource must be updated before to be returned.
